title: Super Mario Boh Boh
blurb: Isolate any Mario vocalisation, loop it eight times, and it stops meaning anything at all — this is that process applied to one of the plumber's stranger noises. Charles Martinet spent decades producing an enormous library of grunts, whoops and half-words for the character, and the internet has found comedy in a remarkable proportion of them. This one is pure nonsense syllables delivered by the most famous voice in gaming. Use it as punctuation, as a greeting, or to fill any silence that was becoming meaningful. Boh boh.
origin: A vocal clip from the Super Mario series.
